summary: The strict plan-view edit succeeded and clears the perspective gate, but repeated bullseye mountain symbols trigger the repetition gate, so this image is not a golden reference.
required_changes: Change only the mountain rendering: replace concentric targets, center dots, and diamonds with irregular connected ridges, saddles, valleys, nonconcentric contours, and variable hatching while preserving every other feature.
